desc: As part of the PLx line, these mounts meet the exacting demands of professional use, offering impeccable craftsmanship and advanced features. PLx Scope Mounts are 100% US-made from 7075 Aluminum and feature grade 12.9 steel hardware with a proprietary Electroless Nickel coating for unmatched durability in austere conditions. The innovative three-bolt design distributes recoil evenly, with over 6,500 lbs of clamping force. Combined with dual machined recoil lugs and 3 cross-bolt lugs, PLx mounts can withstand heavy impacts and sustained gunfire without shifting your zero-all while remaining lightweight and compact. This model features a tall design that places your optic at 2.04", making it a great option for a more heads-up shooting position when using nods.
